sideFaceAudit.provenance: Side gentle v1: native source-mouth-only compact-support resampling, adapted from scripts/refine-kling-expressions.py gentle-v2. The existing painted smile is modestly widened and its corners lifted; eyes, brows, nose, ears, face silhouette, alpha and body are exact. Original half-blinks/blinks and uncertain soft jump expressions are retained. No new face drawing, new source frame or timing change. Adjacent mouth strength eases to zero around source-retained frames. Source classification and native proofs are recorded under artwork/dual-looks/side-face.
